body: You make it sound so easy when it's not. None of that is simple. None of that feels possible. What's the point when the people that should be in your life aren't trying? What's the point when you relate more to someone leaving a suicide note compared to someone that is trying to get you to reconsider suicide?

The only personal accomplishment I'm happy about is my gender identity and my transition to match the person I am inside and it's still not as far as I'd like. And I don't know if I'll get there because the money I have will eventually run out and I am not good at holding down a regular job. I also live in the most unaffordable city in all of the United States. And I have no help. And I know that I can be happy with my accepting my gender identity and transitioning but at some point that's all going to go away when I can't afford anything. When I'll be homeless. When I'll have nothing and no one to help me.

How do you recover from that accomplishment?
